name: The Final Piece
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
The log you found on the high chief looks extensive, but after looking through a couple of the pages, you find that you cannot read the text. The markings are so crude and poorly-formed that you are not sure if anyone would be able to read them.

But perhaps Donova will be able to tell you what it says...
narrative.objectives: Bring the Crudely-written Log to Donova Snowden in Winterspring.
narrative.offerRewardText: I wonder what all of this means... I can't make anything out...

chain.subtitle: 7 quests from level 56 to 59, 33,000 XP in all.

quests.name: Winterfall Firewater
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Empty Firewater Flask to Donova Snowden in Winterspring.

quests.name: Falling to Corruption
quests.objectiveText: Search the Deadwood furbolg camp in northern Felwood for a clue.

quests.name: Mystery Goo
quests.objectiveText: Report back to Donova Snowden with your findings.

quests.name: Toxic Horrors
quests.objectiveText: Collect 3 Toxic Horror Droplets for Donova Snowden in Winterspring.

quests.name: Winterfall Runners
quests.objectiveText: Find the Winterfall Runners and stop them from delivering their shipment to Winterfall Village.

quests.name: The Final Piece
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Crudely-written Log to Donova Snowden in Winterspring.

quests.name: Words of the High Chief
quests.objectiveText: Take the Crudely-written Log to Kelek Skykeeper in southern Felwood.
